findings.finding: The source first says the machine starts in q_0, then calls the same state state one even though the displayed subscript and applicable transition are q_0.
findings.controlling_evidence: The preceding sentence, displayed configuration and transition delta(q_0,stroke) all identify the initial state as q_0.
findings.required_translation_handling: Name q_0 explicitly in the inconsistent sentence and add an adjacent OLTETURMAC-001 disclosure.

findings.finding: The transition tuple uses an otherwise undefined x in its direction coordinate.
findings.controlling_evidence: The formal definition immediately above names the direction coordinate D and restricts it to left, right or stay.
findings.required_translation_handling: Use D and state its three allowed values; add an adjacent OLTETURMAC-002 disclosure.

findings.finding: The source says the input begins immediately to the left end marker, omitting the spatial relation and conflicting with the displayed concatenation.
findings.controlling_evidence: The initial configuration is end-marker concatenated with I, and the preceding paragraph places input on squares to the marker's right.
findings.required_translation_handling: Say the input begins immediately to the right of the left-end marker and add an adjacent OLTETURMAC-003 disclosure.

findings.finding: A run is introduced as a sequence in which every C_i yields C_(i+1), but the next sentence requires a final C_k whose transition is undefined; the literal first condition excludes every halting run.
findings.controlling_evidence: The intended definition must admit finite runs ending at the undefined transition used to define halting, as well as infinite nonhalting runs.
findings.required_translation_handling: Allow finite or infinite sequences and require the one-step condition only where the successor belongs to the sequence; add an adjacent OLTETURMAC-004 disclosure.

findings.finding: The q_0 transition on a stroke is styled as a loop but targets q_1 rather than q_0.
findings.controlling_evidence: To add the two unary blocks, q_0 must traverse the complete first block before its blank transition writes the joining stroke and enters q_1; targeting q_1 after the first stroke does not compute addition.
findings.required_translation_handling: Retarget the loop to q_0 and add an adjacent OLTETURMAC-005 disclosure.

findings.finding: The disciplined version repeats the addition-machine q_0 stroke loop with target q_1.
findings.controlling_evidence: The discipline extension changes the cleanup and halting behavior, not the invariant that q_0 scans the complete first unary block.
findings.required_translation_handling: Retarget the copied loop to q_0 and add an adjacent OLTETURMAC-006 disclosure.

findings.finding: The first piecewise case applies whenever q is in Q, overlapping the third case where q is in Q and delta(q,sigma) is undefined.
findings.controlling_evidence: The explanatory paragraph says to use M's instruction when it exists and enter M-prime's start state exactly when M has no transition.
findings.required_translation_handling: Restrict the first case to defined delta(q,sigma), leaving the third case for undefined transitions, and add an adjacent OLTETURMAC-007 disclosure.

findings.finding: All three copies style the q_0 stroke transition as a loop while targeting q_1.
findings.controlling_evidence: Each diagram implements the same addition stage, which must keep q_0 while traversing the first input block and enter q_1 only on its separating blank.
findings.required_translation_handling: Retarget all three loops to q_0 and add an adjacent OLTETURMAC-008 disclosure.
